column1: # The integration's known-red tests: the failures present at a recorded point, each with a class and a one-line reason.
# scripts/lampway/test_all.py fails a run on ANY failure not listed here, and on any listed test that now passes (the list only shrinks:
# remove the line, or run test_all.py --shrink-baseline). Classes: env (the test environment lacks something: a package, a display, a box),
# inherited (already failing in the pre-session baseline of the fork, scratch/full_base.out), stale (names a file or behaviour this tree
# does not have), broken (a real defect: a fix request), unknown (not triaged yet). Recorded 2026-10-06 at lp/wave5 80ca6de3.
